Parallel search alone does NOT improve 12x12 strength. PR #79 (draft, kept as reference, NOT merged) raised decision-point nodes 4k->24k and depth 2->3 and flipped the 4558d2fe regression, but head-to-head vs incumbent over 16 varied 12x12 openings scored 37.5% (6-10) = neutral-to-weaker. Root cause is the evaluator, not search depth: all 12 real losses are no_moves strangulation and the eval barely values own mobility/liberties. Pivoting to eval (see vs-ai2.32).

Ruled out as specified: no coefficient of scalar mobilityWeight or convex danger D/(mobility+1) beats the incumbent on the deterministic node-budget gate (TestStrangulationEvalNodeBudget, N=1000, exact 50.0% baseline). Nothing shipped — correct call. Key methodological finding: the incumbent is the WRONG opponent for anti-strangulation measurement (it does not strangle); see vs-ai2.33 close + bd memory vs-ai2-tune-against-a-strangler-not-incumbent. The scalars get re-swept vs the strangler in vs-ai2.34. Reusable harness strangulation_eval_test.go preserved in /tmp/virusgame-vs-ai2-32, to be committed by vs-ai2.34.

Validated direction, insufficient magnitude: structural own-fragility penalty (max single-articulation cutLoss) at coef=1 nearly doubles survival vs the strangler (17.5%->30.0% vs arena.MobilityAttacker, n=40 deterministic) but does not scale (coef 3/6/12 monotonically worse) and regresses vs incumbent at n=80 (42.5%). PR #80 stays draft/unmerged as reference. BIG WIN of this task: the reframe — measure anti-strangulation vs a STRANGLER (MobilityAttacker), not the incumbent; incumbent loses 82.5% to it. TestVsStrangler gate preserved in /tmp/virusgame-vs-ai2-33, promoted+continued in vs-ai2.34.

PR #71 bundled this with the superseded vs-ai2.26 eval work and failed its own TRAIN gate. Established fact (PR #79, vs-ai2.34): search depth alone is not the strength lever.
